name: Usage fit section
description: Defines the README section that describes when Lattice is and is not a good fit.
heading: When to use Lattice
items: project knowledge repeatedly drifts between docs, tests, code, and prompts
LLM agents need reliable project context
business rules must stay linked to tests or checks
generated docs should come from validated source material
you want a small, incremental path toward executable documentation
outro: Lattice is probably too much if your project has very little durable domain knowledge, your docs rarely affect implementation, or nobody will run validation, rendering, and audit commands.
